$comment: ClickHouse built-in functions (plan-batch3 WP-CH), generated by WP-CH from a curated list (ClickHouse 24.x). Aggregates accept the combinator suffixes (-If, -Array, -State, -Merge …).

functions.name: count
functions.doc: Number of rows (count()) or of non-NULL values of x. Combinators: -If, -Array, -Distinct, -OrNull, -OrDefault, -State, -Merge, -MergeState, -ForEach, -Resample (e.g. countIf(x, cond)).
